Experimental results show that a vibration frequency of 45 kHz and spatial resolution of 15 m can be accurately demodulated in a 2 km fiber link.

articleTitle: Satellite Resource Reservation Algorithm Based on ARIMA Model with Balanced Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a resource reservation algorithm based on ARIMA model with balanced performance (RABP) is proposed. The algorithm uses Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) model to predict the change trend of future on-board traffic to reserve reasonable spectrum resources in advance and evaluate the impact of resource allocation scheme on system performance. The simulation results show that the performance of resource utilization and communication blocking rate are improved.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Monitoring of CD and OSNR Based on Delay-Tap Sampling and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We demonstrated a simultaneous CD and OSNR monitoring method for NRZ-OOK signals by employing the delay-tap sampling and image processing techniques. The monitoring ranges of OSNR and CD are 14–30 dB and 0–1275 ps/nm, respectively.

articleTitle: Study on the working temperature characteristics of methane sensor by directional ordered Al2O3 nanotubes confined catalysis
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to solve the high working temperature of catalytic gas sensor, a catalytic gas sensor based on ceramic micro-hotplate is fabricated by MEMS technology, which will help to improve the stability of the sensor.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Ethanol Gas Sensing Characteristics of Microbottle Resonator Based on Whispering Gallery Mode
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper mainly studied the ethanol gas sensing characteristics of silica microbottle resonator coupled with non-adiabatic tapered fiber based on whispering gallery mode (WGM). The main research contents were the bulk refractive index sensitivity of silica microbottle resonator and the sensing characteristics of ethanol gas after being coated with graphene oxide (GO) and polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS), respectively. Experiments reveal that the bulk refractive index sensitivity of the silica microbottle resonator is 21.14941nm/RIU. The sensitivity of WGM silica microbottle resonator coated with GO to ethanol gas is about 1.55 pm/ppm. For the silica microbottle resonator sensor coated with PDMS, the sensitivity to ethanol gas is about 13.13 pm/ppm when the concentration is between 5.8ppm to 117ppm, and 1.44 pm/ppm when the concentration is between 117 ppm to 204.25 ppm.

articleTitle: Train-induced vibration analysis of subway tunnel under different train speeds based on optical fiber accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A long-term and real-time monitoring for train-induced vibration response of subway tunnel based on optical fiber accelerometers is proposed. The vibration response characteristics of subway tunnel under different train speeds is analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on Phase Noise Characteristics of Optical Fiber Sensing System Based on Remotely Pumped Light Amplification
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Remotely Optically Pumped Amplifier is an important form of the interference type optical fiber sensing remote relay transmission system. In this paper, the relationship between the nonlinear spontaneous Raman effect and the sensor phase noise in remotely pumped optical amplification is studied. The results show that in a 100km transmission system, with the increase of pump power the spontaneous Raman effect increases and a random fluctuation of pump optical power. The pump light fluctuation leads to the gain distortion and decrease of the remote gain unit, which ultimately transforms the pump intensity noise into the phase noise of the system. The experimental results show that when the pump power is controlled below 1.1W, the phase noise of the remotely pumped optical amplification system is at - 98dB@1kHz. And there are no obvious phase noise introduced into the remotely pump optical amplification system.

articleTitle: Encapsulated Sapphire Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor with Improved High-Temperature Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Single-crystal sapphire fiber sensors typically have a significant performance deterioration at high temperatures due to the corrosion of pollutants in the external environment. Thus, we propose and demonstrate a novel packaging method to protect them. Such an inert gas packaging method could effectively suppress the formation of microstructural features, such as loss spots, on the surface of sapphire fiber at high temperatures. Therefore, the high-temperature stability of sapphire fiber Bragg grating (SFBG) sensors is greatly enhanced, and they can work stably at 1600 °C for up to 20 hours. In addition, the high-temperature response of these inert-gas-packaged SFBG sensors was tested, and the experimental results showed that they are available for temperature sensing up to 1800 °C with a sensitivity of 49.6 pm/°C, Such inert-gas-packaged SFBG sensors are ideal candidates for high-temperature sensing in many areas such as the aerospace field and the petrochemical industry.

articleTitle: All Optical Service Networks Architecture and Protocols for Integration of Space and Ground
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The advance of the sixth generation (6G) network made the integration of space and ground network become a trend in the future. To realize global coverage and flexible connection, satellite communication is attracting more and more attention. However, space networks based on microwaves have limitations such as scarcer resource of spectrum, large attenuation. Therefore, laser communication is recommended. But the existed transmission technologies have difficulties in satisfying the various requirement of transport performance of personalized services. The network is needed to be more flexible facing services. In this paper, we proposed all optical service networks for integration of space and ground to implement 6G. First, an network architecture was illustrated. Then we summarized some key technologies in the architecture. In the end, we proposed three open issues to be discussed.

articleTitle: High-Bandwidth Frequency Servo Loop for Resonant Micro Optic Gyroscope with a Reduced Sampling Rate Proportional-Derivative Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: To suppress the high frequency noise in resonant micro optic gyroscope, this paper proposes a reduced sampling rate proportional-derivative control loop. Simulation results show that the loop bandwidth is broaden to 19.3 kHz.

articleTitle: Graphene enabled all-optical controllable photonic devices and their applications
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: All-optical controllable photonic devices have attracted more and more attention for their excellent performances of all-optical controllability, without mechanical structure, high compactness, fast response speed and stable regulation. Here, we will present our recent research achievements in graphene enabled all-optical controllable photonic devices and their applications in filter and sensor.

articleTitle: New insights into fiber-optic mode transition
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The mechanism of mode transition is obtained, showing that mode transition corresponds to the generation of phase-matched film waveguide modes including film guided modes and film cladding modes, which occurs from the last fiber mode.

articleTitle: Method of multi-domain synchronization network planning via quantum annealing
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A quantum-inspired method for multi-domain synchronization network planning is explored and proposed, formulated to multi-variable quadratic models via quantum annealing approach proving better experimental results of optimal performance and completing time comparing with simulated annealing.

articleTitle: The optimization of error floor in M-QAM multilevel coded modulation scheme based on LDPC code
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In M-QAM multilevel coded modulation scheme with LDPC, the system error floor can be effectively reduced and the coding gain can be improved by adjusting the component code rate based on the capacity rule.

articleTitle: Two-Octave Supercontinuum Generation of OAM Modes in Ring Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Recent progress on supercontinuum generation of OAM modes in optical fiber is reviewed. Two-octave SC generation of up to OAM17,1 mode spanning from 1560 to 6250 nm in the high-index ring fiber will be discussed.

articleTitle: All-fiber linear sampling device for absolute distance measurement
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An all-fiber linear sampling device for dual-comb time-of-flight (TOF) distance measurement is demonstrated. We studied the impact of optical filter and adjustable attenuator on the symmetry of the interferometric beat-note, the optimization of which is crucial for TOF extraction. In an absolute ranging experiment, a ranging precision of 49 um is obtained at an update rate of 2 kHz and the precision can be improved to 7 um with 100 ms averaging time. This technique shows the potential of high precision absolute ranging in many practical industrial scenarios.

articleTitle: Unsensitive-bending Mach-Zehnder interferometer for the detection of the Clostridium alpha toxin
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An unsensitive-bending Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) structure is proposed to detect the Clostridium alpha toxin by using single-mode fiber dislocation fusion. A standard single-mode fiber (SMF) is offset laterally and spliced between two SMFs to form the U-shaped microcavity in the middle, which is used for sensing. The MZI structure is encapsulated with capillary tube and injected with pure water, and the temperature sensitivity is tested in the temperature range of 26–50 °C. The temperature sensitivity of MZI is 0.78nm/°C, which ensures its practicability in the environment of temperature fluctuation. The axial tension and radial strain of MZI structure are measured. The weight range of the load is 10 to 60g. The experimental results show that the sensitivity of axial tension is −30.43 nm/N and the sensitivity of radial pressure is only −1.54 nm/N. The sensitivity of axial tension is about 20 times of radial pressure sensitivity. In the subsequent sensing experiments, axial fixation is needed to ensure the stability of MZI, the effect of radial pressure can be ignored under certain circumstances. Finally, the bending insensitive interferometer is used to detect the Clostridium alpha toxin, The sensing properties of MZI structure at concentrations of 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>, 2–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>, 2–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 2–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> were studied. When the concentration is 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>, the peak wavelength shift of the transmission spectrum can reach to 4.25 nm. Therefore, the proposed unsensitive-bending sensor has the advantages of high refractive index sensitivity, small size and low cost, which has a good prospect in biosensor applications.

articleTitle: A comprehensive nonlinear filter scheme for 50Gb/s PAM4-PON Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A comprehensive nonlinear filter scheme for 50Gb/s PAM4-PON systems is proposed in this paper. In our scheme, both the forward symbols and the backward symbols of the Volterra filter are considered and the decision term is added after the Volterra filter to better eliminate the inter-symbol interference (ISI). An experiment of 50Gb/s PAM4 transmission is demonstrated over 20 km SSMF. Results show that a link power gain of 1.3 dB can be obtained at the HD-FEC threshold (3.8×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup>) compared to the Volterra filter.

articleTitle: Multi-channel High Power Laser Array Chip for Silicon Photonic Integration
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a new kind of distributed feedback (DFB) laser based on sampled grating with non-central phase shift. The output facet of the laser is coated with antireflection (AR) film. Another facet is coated with high-reflection (HR) film to improve output power. Non-central phase shift is introduced for better single longitudinal mode (SLM) operation. Precise wavelength is achieved by changing sampling periods. A 16-channel DFB laser array is experimentally fabricated and shows high output power over 150 mW, high side mode suppression ratio (SMSR) above 45 dB, and low wavelength deviation less than 0.3 nm.

articleTitle: Research on Damage Characteristics of CFRP Based on DFB Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Damage characteristics study of CFRP laminates based on DFB fiber laser is proposed. The AE detection experiment shows that the DFB fiber laser can reliably detect AE signals, and the proposed maximal overlap discrete wavelet transforms (MODWT) method can recognize damage characteristics of CFRP laminates during initiation, spread, and instability stages.

articleTitle: Ultracompct and High Performance Silicon High-order Mode Waveguide Bends
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper demonstrates a series of high-order mode waveguide bends with an ultra-compact footprint and high performance. Gradient-based inverse design with level set method is utilized endow the device excellent critical dimension control.

articleTitle: Study of CIGS Absorber Thickness and Gradient Bandgap effect on Device Performance
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper uses wxAMPS software to carry out simulation calculation about the influence of parameter changes on device performance of copper indium gallium selenide (CIGS) thin film solar cell, with structure of soda lime glass substrate/Mo thin film bottom electrode/CIGS absorber layer/CdS buffer layer/i-ZnO thin film high resistance layer/AZO thin film transparent conductive layer. With different absorption layer thickness, we simulate the gradient distribution of the band gap of the CIGS thin-film absorption layer in the solar cell. By calculating the device efficiency with the minimum band gap at different positions, we have found the most suitable position of the minimum band gap for this model is near the front absorption layer and the device efficiency with absorption layer thickness 1.5um is similar to that of 2um, which means the thin absorption layer of the solution method can be effective.

articleTitle: Performance of organic light emitting diodes with MoO3 and PEDOT:PSS as double hole injection layers
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The carrier injection capability of organic light emitting diodes (OLED) has a big influence on its performance such as the brightness and efficiency. Poly(3,4- ethylenedioxythiophene): poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT: PSS) is the most commonly used hole injection material in OLED. However, PEDOT: PSS is hygroscopic and acidic, so it will corrode the ITO electrode and deteriorate the long-term performance of the device. In this paper, a P-type metal oxide- MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is introduced between ITO and PEDOT:PSS by thermal evaporation, and MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> films of different thicknesses are made to explore the influence of MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> thickness on device performance. Studies show that the introduction of MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> not only enhances the hole injection capability, but also acts as a buffer layer between ITO and PEDOT:PSS to prevent the acidic and hygroscopic PEDOT:PSS from corroding the electrode. The MoO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/PEDOT:PSS double hole injection layer improves the efficiency and stability of the device.

articleTitle: Passively mode-locking in 2 µm region based on Sb2Se3 saturable absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, the nonlinear optical modulation characteristics and optical switch capabilities of Sb2Se3 were demonstrated with a 2 µm mode-locked fiber laser. The central wavelength was 1961.35 nm, and the 3-dB bandwidth was 4.57 nm. The pulses repetition rate was 22.36 MHz, and the pulse width was 890 fs. The experimental results demonstrated that Sb2Se3 had promising future in generating ultrashort pulses.

articleTitle: SC-Loc:Milli-meter Accuracy Localization based on Visible Light Screen Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a logo-based positioning system. First, the system uses the designed DPOTSU algorithm to enable the monocular camera to be positioned at a long distance. Secondly, this system uses the camera ranging principle to estimate the distance and angle from the object to the logo. Finally, the system uses the designed logo to transmit the absolute position coordinates required for positioning. A solution for simultaneous high-precision positioning and long-distance has been developed.

articleTitle: BER Performance Analysis of Ground-to-UAV FSO SIMO Links with Optimized Channel Model
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The BER of Ground-to-UAV-FSO-SIMO links with our optimized channel model is analyzed. Simulation results show that the BER can be significantly decreased by increasing the number of receiving apertures when receiving area is the same.

articleTitle: Mode-locked laser with high-order mode generation based on grating combiner
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an all-fiber passively mode-locked laser that generates high-order mode. A grating combiner of a few-mode long-period fiber grating and a few-mode fiber Bragg grating are introduced into the laser cavity to achieve the purposes of mode conversion and mode selection. The result of the mode-locked high-order mode pulse with a spectral width of 0.06 nm of 3 dB and a repetition rate of 12.88 MHz has been obtained, and the signal to noise ratio is as high as 68 dB.

articleTitle: Fourier Domain Mode Locking Optoelectronic Oscillator for VCO-output Signal Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A Fourier domain mode locking (FDML) optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) based on stimulated Brillouin scattering is demonstrated to optimize the signal performance from a voltage controlled oscillator (VCO). Experimental results indicate that the signal from the FDML OEO has a much lower phase noise and a better coherence than the signal output from the VCO.

articleTitle: Mode-Dependent Characterization of Rayleigh Backscattering in Ring-Core Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The mode-dependent characteristic of Rayleigh backscattering in a ring-core fiber is theoretically and experimentally demonstrated. Compared to few-mode fiber, the Rayleigh backscattering of high-order orbital momentum mode supported by ring-core fiber bears much resemblance.

articleTitle: Ultra-sharp Fano resonances based on two-hole-assisted side-coupled multi-mode racetrack microring structure
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a multi-mode racetrack micro-ring resonator, side-coupled with a bus waveguide to generate an ultra-sharp Fano resonance lineshapes. The slope rate can reach ~968 dB/nm and the extinction ratio is ~7 dB.

articleTitle: Satellite local node state awareness and adaptive forwarding routing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Adaptive forwarding routing algorithm is proposed in order to solve the problem that the traditional routing algorithm is insensitive to the dynamic change of satellite network state. This algorithm mainly uses the real-time perception of local network state, to realize load balancing. The simulation results show that it achieves shorter end-to-end delay and lower packet loss rate.

articleTitle: Predicting Effective Refractive Indices of Multimode Waveguide via Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to accelerate the multimode waveguide design, several regression models are employed to predict the effective refractive indices (n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">eff</inf>) from fundamental mode to fourth-order TE mode with various waveguide geometric parameters. On dataset with air cladding, the percent of eligible data whose prediction error is less than 10–<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> of different modes are respectively 89.95%, 88.10%, 82.29%, 75.83%, 71.19%. And on dataset with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> cladding, they are 95.40%, 92.81 %, 90.90%, 81.99%, 86.39%. This study guides the structural design and optimization of optical waveguides based on machine learning.

articleTitle: Metal-oxide field-effect transistors for display and beyond
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Metal oxide field-effect transistors (FETs) have potential applications in display, flexible electronic device. Here, we will report the advance of our OLED display, metal oxide FETs, and application in beyond display. We have paid more attention to the stability improvement, interface trap of MO-TFT, and application in CMOS circuit, artificial synapse and gas sensor.

articleTitle: Analog PAM4 modulation technique enabled by a polarization multiplexing modulator
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new method to generate radio-frequency (RF) pulse-amplitude-modulation with four amplitude levels (PAM4) signals. This method is a cost-effective one without the use of expensive digital to analog converters (DACs). By using a polarization multiplexing modulator that integrates two polarization orthogonal intensity modulators, the two polarization orthogonal intensity modulators are driven by two levels of RF signals, respectively. Then, by cascading a polarization controller (PC) and a polarizer, RF PAM4 optical signals can be generated. Based on our proposed scheme, we experimentally demonstrate the generation of RF PAM4 signal at 9.07GHz. Our experimental results show that the RF PAM4 signals have no obvious deterioration after transmission over 80km single mode fiber (SMF).

articleTitle: Research on Multi-band Fiber Transmission System with Multi-carrier and Adaptive Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a novel multi-band transmission system based on multi-carrier and adaptive modulation is proposed. The simulation results show that the scheme can effectively improve the performance of system.

articleTitle: Four-channel high-speed strain measurement based on VT-DBR laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Wavelength-shifting interferometry (WSI) based technology enables simultaneous high-speed demodulation of four channels of strain sensors. The four sensors are based on extrinsic Fabry-Perot interferometry (EFPI), which are constructed by splicing a section of hollow-core fiber (HCF) of about 500µm between two single-mode fiber (SMF) segments. Each sensor corresponds to one demodulation channel. We use a vernier-turned distributed Bragg reflector (VT-DBR) laser for high-speed wavelength switching, which introduces a phase shift in the wavelength domain. Based on five-step phase-shifting algorithm, phase recovery is performed with any five adjacent phase-shifting signal to achieve high-speed and stable phase demodulation. Experimental results show that this measurement system can be well applied to high-speed measurement of strain.

articleTitle: Study on the performance of fiber cladding diameter to humidity sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Reducing the diameter of FBG cladding by hydrofluoric acid can improve the sensitivity and response speed of humidity sensor, and has little effect on repeatability.

articleTitle: Switchable dual-wavelength random fiber laser based on random grating array
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A switchable dual-wavelength random fiber laser using a Fabry-Perot filter to select different lasing wavelengths is proposed. By adjusting the pump power, wavelength selecting and switching can be realized.

articleTitle: Bandwidth broadening for CS-MMI-based Optical Quantizer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We broaden the narrow operation bandwidth of our previously proposed CS-MMI-based optical quantizer by using the material of Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>. Simulation results show that the operation range is broadened from 12nm to 43nm for ENOB>3bit.

articleTitle: Refractive index and temperature sensor based on no-core fiber and few-mode fiber coupling
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An interferometric fiber optic sensor based on no-core fiber (NCF) is proposed, and small sections of few-mode fiber (FMF) are fused to each end of the NCF to enhance the sensitivities of the sensor. The refractive index sensitivities of this structure are 171.29 nm/RIU from 1.35 to 1.41 and 892.56 nm/RIU from 1.41 to 1.43, respectively. The temperature sensitivity is 0.06684 nm/°C from 30°C to 90°C. The proposed sensor has the advantages of simple structure, low cost and anti-electromagnetic interference, which can be widely used in biological and chemical fields.

articleTitle: Simplified Radius-directed Linear Kalman Filter for Blind Polarization Demultiplexing of PDM-QPSK Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a blind polarization demultiplexing scheme for PDM-QPSK signal, which reduces computational complexity but retains the tracking capability of ultrafast RSOP by comparison with the radius-directed linear Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Dual-mode interference microfiber vibration sensor based on rectangular beam with through hole
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A reflected microfiber vibration sensor is proposed. The axial strain and vibration characteristics of the proposed sensor are experimentally studied. The results show that the axial strain sensitivity is −3.65pm/µε, the acceleration sensitivity is 0.15214V/g at 35Hz, and the frequency detection range is 30 – 3500Hz. The compact structure, high sensitivity and simple manufacturing method make the microfiber vibration sensor great prospect in mechanical and acoustic vibration field.

articleTitle: Effect of Refractive Index Profile of Multimode-fiber on Nonlinear Beam Self-cleaning
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: For the nonlinear ultrashort pulse propagation in multimode fiber, we find that beam self-cleaning can be achieved by optimizing the refractive index profile of the fiber to minimize the modal dispersion.

articleTitle: Role of the FBG's bandwidth in long distance point sensing system based on random fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We study the influence of the fiber Bragg grating (FBG)'s bandwidth on the performance of the long distance point sensing system based on random fiber laser. The results show that the optical signal-to-noise ratio (OSNR) decreases gradually when the bandwidth of the FBG increases by simulation, under the same pump power, which is demonstrated by the experiment. This work could provide a reference for designing a long-distance optical fiber sensing system.

articleTitle: The Construction of Public Security Emergency Communication Architecture Based on Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: With the development of aerospace technology and the advantages of space network in emergency communication, the Space-Earth Integration Network with strong information support ability has gradually become an important means for public security departments to solve the problem of emergency communication. Based on the conventional application of public security emergency communication, this paper discusses how to build a new system of public security emergency communication support by adding portable satellite communication station and police UAV.

articleTitle: Thulium-doped fiber random laser operated at 1950 nm
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A thulium doped fiber random laser pumped by 793 nm and operated at 1946.8 nm is presented. It uses a random fiber grating for distributed random feedback and a fiber loop mirror to form a half-open cavity structure to reduce the pump threshold. Random laser with threshold power of 2.3 W and optical-signal-to-noise ratio of 38 dB is obtained.

articleTitle: Ternary solar cells with polymer donor and two nonfullerene acceptors
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The third component has a strong effect on light absorption, energy level, and morphology of ternary blend film for all nonfullerene acceptors. Thus, the choice of the third component is required reasonably made. In this study, nonfullerene acceptor IT-2Cl and IT-4Cl are employed as the additional components to enhance PTB7-Th: 6TIC-4F based solar cells. IT-2Cl with a higher LUMO energy level could effectively elevate the voltages of ternary devices. IT-4Cl provides good complementary absorption to PTB7-Th and 6TIC-4F, which benefits for improving J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf>. In addition, both IT-2Cl and IT-4Cl improve the morphologies of the blends and thus help to enhance charge collection and transport of ternary devices. As a result, enhanced PCE values of 11.4% and 11.3% can be achieved for ternary solar cells with the addition of IT-2Cl and IT-4Cl, respectively. These results provide a guideline to select the third component for constructing high-efficiency ternary solar cells with two nonfullerenes.

articleTitle: A broadband single-polarization single-mode hollow core anti-resonant optical fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An anti-resonant hollow core fiber with an ultra-wide bandwidth of single-polarization single-mode (SPSM) operation is realized and analyzed in this paper. Double-ring circular cladding structure is introduced to control the reflection area and suppress high-order modes for the proposed fiber. To achieve SPSM behavior, an epsilon negative (ENG) material is fully filled in the selected cladding tubes to manipulate the effective material absorption loss (EML). By changing the parameters of the proposed fiber, the wanted (X-polarized) and unwanted (Y-polarized and high order) modes yield large loss differences (LD), i.e., SPSM guidance. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the fiber exhibits an extra-wide SPSM wavelength bandwidth (from 1450 nm to 1620 nm) in conditions of minimum LD > 100 dB/m.

articleTitle: A Broadband Polarization Beam Splitter Based on Compressed Hexagonal Structure and Liquid Crystal-Filled Dual-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A broadband polarization beam splitter (PBS) based on compressed hexagonal structure and liquid crystal-filled dual-core photonic crystal fiber is proposed. The bandwidth of the proposed PBS is 280 nm, covering the S, C, L, and U communication bands. Besides, it has a short length of 109.5 µm and an extinction ratio of 63 dB at the communication wavelength of 1.55 µm.

articleTitle: Broadband luminescence characteristics of PbS/PbSe co-doped silica fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A novel PbS/PbSe co-doped fiber is fabricated by the modified chemical vapor deposition (MCVD) technology. Its absorption and luminescence characteristics are investigated. There are two absorption peaks at 773 and 1161 nm, respectively. The luminescence spectrum ranges from 1000 to 1350 nm. In addition, the intensity of luminescence is related to pump power.

articleTitle: DSP-Free Coherent Receiver based on 3×3 Coupler for OOK Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We have demonstrated a DSP-free coherent receiver based on 3×3 coupler for 10-Gb/s OOK signals by simulation. We analyze the laser phase noise, chromatic dispersion and the phase rotation angle deviation tolerance, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimized Decision Method Based on K-means- TKNN for Coherent Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a nonlinear equalization method based on K-means-Tailored K-Nearest Neighbors (K-means-TKNN) algorithm. The simulation results show that the computational complexity of K-means-TKNN can be reduced to 20.3 % of that of the traditional KNN algorithm for the 64-QAM system.

articleTitle: Collaborative Allocation of Computing, Storage, and Transport Resources for Data Center Allopatric Services in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a resource allocation algorithm that considers computing, storage and transport resources collaboratively for data center allopatric services in elastic optical network (EON). Simulation results show the proposed algorithm can reduce service congestion rate and improve resource utilization.

articleTitle: Research on Ethyl Cellulose Flexible Inductive Humidity Sensor Based on Biomass Hair Modification
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional humidity sensor design, a flexible inductive humidity sensor based on ethyl cellulose hair modification is proposed. The thermal purification working mode of the humidity sensor is studied, and its performance is tested by the data acquisition system. The experiment shows, the sensitivity of the sensor is 118.92Hz/%RH, Response time is less than 700s, Dampness is 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>RH, Weekly drift is within ±3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>RH. The flexible inductive humidity sensor developed in this paper has high sensitivity performance, which verifies that a new method of humidity testing by inductance. It is more suitable for wearable scenarios and has a wide range of potential for humidity detection applications.

articleTitle: Modeling analysis of vortex beams propagation through a merged atmospheric turbulence and aerosol medium
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this work, we theoretically proposed a model of vortex beams transmitting in a merged atmospheric turbulence and aerosol medium, which based on the extended Huygens-Fresnel diffraction principle. Fourier transform (FT) method augmented with subharmonics and correlation function method were used to produce turbulence phase screens and aerosol phase screens, respectively. Simulation results show that the phase distortion caused by aerosol scattering significantly affects the OAM spectrum of vortex beams. The stability of vortex beams falls with the rises of topological charge (TC) number in merged medium.

articleTitle: Application and Development of Microwave Photonics Technology in Space TT&C System: Invited Paper
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The traditional space telemetry, tracking, command and communication system works in the radio frequency band. With the improvement on measurement accuracy and communication capacity in space missions, the traditional means have a certain bottleneck in dealing with the development of future space missions. The inherent lightweight, high parallel, high capacity and fine processing capabilities of Optics and microwave photonics show the potential to solve the above problems. This paper summarizes the innovative work of the Southwest China Institute of Electronic Technology in the application of laser measurement and communication integration, microwave photonic RF front-end technology in space telemetry, tracking, command and communication system. The experimental platform is established for verification, the accuracy of ranging and velocity measurement reaches millimeter level at 10Gbps single channel transmission rate with 1E-9 bit error rate under a simulation satellite-ground link. The microwave photonic RF front-end can be compatible with S to Ka band, with a sampling rate of 20Gsps and a signal bandwidth of 5GHz. It is expected to be applied to next generation of space telemetry, tracking, command and communication system or navigation and relay system.

articleTitle: Fiber chromatic dispersion measurements based on programmable spectrum shaping and wavelength-to-time mapping
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A fiber dispersion measurement method based on programmable spectrum shaping and wavelength-to-time mapping is experimentally demonstrated. The dispersion in a 4-km fiber is measured, and the results agree with the values provided by manufacturer.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Power Domain Multiplexing /Access for Flexible Optical Access Network
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the significant research interests of the PDM/PDA PON in terms of nonorthogonal multiple access, hierarchical modulation and nonuniform PAM. In addition, the brief reviews of some challenging areas are summarized.

articleTitle: Photodetector based on Fiber integrated with MXene Nb2CTx
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A highly sensitive all-optical photodetector is proposed based on the strong evanescent field of the microfiber and the excellent photothermal effect of Nb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>CT<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>. This photodetector has widespread applications in spectroscopy, communications, and night vision.

articleTitle: Cost-efficient Parallel Service Function Chain with Elaborate Layout for Elastic Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposed a kind of cost-efficient parallel service function chain with elaborate layout, which can effectively reduce the resource overhead of packet copying and significantly reduce the latency of SFC at the meanwhile.

articleTitle: Research on Self-calibration Strategy of Workpiece Processing Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Self-calibration processing equipment is studied through measuring the precise size of the workpiece produced in the factory assembly line based on the machine vision measurement technology. Hough circle detection algorithm and subpixel edge algorithm are adopted. After several experiments, the measuring accuracy of the device can reach 0.05mm, which meets the design requirements of measurement accuracy. The self-calibration parameters are sent to the processing equipment through the transmission layer to reduce the rejection rate and improve the enterprise benefits.

articleTitle: Loss Characteristics of Polymer Optical Waveguide at 1310 nm Wavelength on An Optical Printed Circuit Board
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper presents the fabrication of a low-loss optical waveguide at 1310 nm on an optical printed circuit board. UV lithography and low-loss UV curable polymer material (ZPU-RI) is used for the fabrication. The experimental results show that minimal optical loss is 0.42 dB/cm as the waveguide length is 3.8 cm.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength thulium-doped fiber laser by using Sagnac loop mirror
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A multi-wavelength thulium-doped fiber laser based on a Sagnac loop mirror is demonstrated. By increasing pump power and adjusting the state of polarization, stable laser outputs with single, double, three, four or five wavelengths are realized within the spectral range between 1954 and 1975 nm. The laser has a high side-mode suppression ratio (SMSR) of 40–50 dB.

articleTitle: Vector vortex beams encoding/decoding for visible-light communications
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: By using a spatial light modulator, we firstly generate 16 states of vector vortex beams, then by encoding and decoding them, a 60-by-60-pixels gray image was transmitted and recovered successfully in the visible band.

articleTitle: Link optimization for fiber communication network with sensing capability
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Real-time access to the link state information of fiber communication network can improve the quality of communication, which is of great significance to the network robust. Therefore, this paper proposes a link failure monitoring method, which is easy to obtain link state information and to optimize link thereafter. In the fiber communication network model, the parameters of network topology and sensing capability are introduced into the fuzzy logic system and numerical study are carried out. The study explores the influence of Poisson parameter, number of links, number of nodes and sensing capability factors on the probability of link failure in fiber communication network.

articleTitle: Practical Phase Noise Model for Continuous Variable Quantum Key Distribution with a Real Local Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In continuous-variable quantum key distribution with a local local oscillator (LLO CV-QKD), the phase noise after phase compensation is mainly composed of three parts: the relative phase drift noise, the relative phase accumulated noise, and the phase-reference measurement noise. Here, we develop a practical phase noise model for LLO CV-QKD protocols, in which part of the phase-reference measurement noise that can be locally calibrated by Bob at the receiver side is considered to be trusted noise. It is reasonable to adopt this model because Bob”s apparatus is inaccessible to the eavesdropper. We show that the secret key rate and the transmission distance of the LLO CV-QKD system under the practical phase noise model is significantly improved in comparison to that under the conventional phase noise model. We show that the secret key rate is improved more than 65% and the transmission distance is increased more than 70% with some typical simulation parameters.

articleTitle: Impact of silver nanospheres array for enhanced optical absorption in plasmonic-based InGaAs photodetector
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A new structure of InGaAs photodetector with surface-modified Ag nanospheres array is proposed, which can obtain 50% optical absorptance at 1550nm and maintain good optical absorption performance when the light incident within 0–30 degree.

articleTitle: Design of Dual Band Microstrip Filter Based on SIR
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: As the core device in the field of communication, filter is developing towards miniaturization and high frequency. In this paper, a new dual frequency filter based on step impedance resonator is proposed. The resonant frequencies of the proposed stepped impedance resonator (SIR) dual frequency filter are 2.4GHz and 5.2GHz, and the isolation is greater than 20dB.

articleTitle: Optical Fiber Nonlinearity Equalizer Based Perturbation Theory on Deep Neural Network Classifier
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, based on DNN, we reconstructed input features through I/Q data at receiving side with perturbation theory and proposed a new classifier FEP-DNN.

articleTitle: Optimization of Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation Algorithm for Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The article adopts the method of analyzing the dynamic bandwidth allocation of the next-generation passive optical network, and proposes a dynamic bandwidth allocation algorithm that supports the quality of service and the level of service.

articleTitle: A Groove Parameter Processing Method Based on Hierarchical Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of inaccurate calculation of groove parameters caused by cutting defects of blade, offset of cellulose paper position, uneven filling of tow and other factors in the measurement of grooved filter rod, a processing method of groove parameters based on hierarchical clustering analysis is proposed. In this method, the spatial distance similarity between the detected data points is used to cluster the detected groove parameter data layer by layer, then one or several data points with the greatest difference are filtered out. After this method was used the false detection rate is reduced from 4.64% to 0.7%.

articleTitle: Low-Loss Fan-In/Fan-Out Device for 8-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper we report the design, fabrication and measurement of a novel 8-core FiFo device using fused tapering method and trench-assisted bridge fiber. The device is constitutive of 8-core fiber, tapered bridge fiber bundle and single-mode fibers. The minimum and maximum insertion loss of the Fi/Fo device are 0.25 dB and 0.98 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Probabilistically Shaped PAM-8 for Few Mode IM/DD Links with a Training Sequence Aided CMA
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated the PS-PAM-8 performance in few mode fiber with a Training Sequence Aided CMA algorithm. The results show that the proposed TA-CMA can achieve a~ 1dB gain for receiver sensitivity.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Multi-Mode Converter for Optical Delay Line Application
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Optical delay lines (ODL) are one of the key components in integrated photonic circuits and systems. We propose a novel optical delay line structure based on multimode conversion. The silicon multi-mode converter is optimized via an inverse design method to simultaneously convert the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{TEi}$</tex> modes to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{TE}_{\mathrm{i}}+1$</tex> modes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{i}=1,2$</tex>, and 3) at the wavelength of 1550 nm. It only occupies an area of 4 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathbf{m}\times 3 \mu\mathbf{m}$</tex>. Simulation results show that the insertion loss of the mode-order converter is less than 1.6 dB and the crosstalk is lower than −22 dB for all three modes.

articleTitle: Temperature Monitoring System of Fiber Bragg Grating of Transformer Based on High-precision Demodulating Algorithm by Wavelet Denoising
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Temperature accuracy of the temperature monitoring system can reach ± 0.05 °C and the average wavelength error after wavelength demodulation is better than 0.5pm in the range of 60°C to 80°C.

articleTitle: Phase bias in dual-axis optical gyroscope based on a double-ring structure
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A two axes fiber optical gyroscope comprising a two loops structure (TLS) using a 3 × 3 coupler is presented. The length of the two loops is 2 m and 1.8 m. When one of the two axes is vertical to another, a dual-axis gyroscope comes into being. The phase difference between the counter-propagating waves in TLS is calculated and discussed. The sensitivity can be improved by adding a bias phase, but only if the phase difference is a monotonic function of the angular rate, with the best sensitivity obtained by adding a phase bias of ±3π/2.
