articleTitle: Demonstration of Flexible Access in Rate-Adaptive Visible Light Communication System with Constellation Probabilistic Shaping
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Distance-based rate-adaptive visible-light-communication system with probabilistic shaping is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. We achieved flexible access with the net data-rate from 1.84 to 3.27-Gbps for 20 and 1-meter distance, with maximum 28% overall capacity improvement.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Hydrogen Sensor Fault Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The fault detection of hydrogen sensor is the essential condition of hydrogen sensor operating. Therefore, it is of great significance to design and implement a hydrogen sensor fault detection device. In this paper, a hydrogen detection device based on STM32 is designed. Using the device, the signal data of hydrogen sensor can be collected, including partial fault signal data and normal working signal data of hydrogen sensor. The data is sent to the upper computer, and the experimental data is input into the algorithm for fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: High-Numerical-Aperture(NA) Microwave Metasurface Lens(Metalens) and Its Applications in High-Gain Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The NA is a basic parameter of a lens, which can determine its focusing spot size in the far field. High NA(close to 0.9 or above) metalens with a deep sub-wavelength focusing spot is an important metadevice in the modern optics and photonics. In this paper, a four-layer microwave metalens and its applications in the high-gain and low-profile antenna are studied and demonstrated. A high NA=0.88 (FWHM is 0.57λ) metalens based on high transmission phase gradient metasurface is firstly designed and is also verified by experimental result. Besides, a feeding source is placed at the focal spot of the proposed metalens, and a quasi-spherical wave is emitted and then transformed to a plane wave. Thus, a high gain antenna is obtained and the beam-width of the bare antenna is also significantly decreased. The simulated results show that the gain of the high NA metalens is largely enhanced by 10.47dB compared to bare antenna at the frequency of optimized 9GHz. More importantly, the relation between the focusing efficiency of high NA metalens and the enhanced gain of lens antenna is discussed and highlighted. The work opens new avenues to design high-gain lens antenna based on high NA plasmonic metalens in the microwave band.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Liquid Detector Based on Fuzzy Inference
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An intelligent liquid leakage detector is proposed. In the structural design, the photoelectric liquid detection unit, the temperature detection unit, the medium conductivity detection unit and the seawater level rise rate detection unit are integrated and integrated. Designed the measurement circuit of each unit. Realize the detection of leaking liquid, and assist in the detection of seawater infiltration rate. And use the method of fuzzy inference to judge the temperature and conductivity characteristic data to realize the intelligent judgment of the type of leakage liquid.

articleTitle: Wavelength-switchable spatiotemporal mode-locked multimode fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a wavelength-switchable spatiotemporal mode-locked multimode fiber laser, which relies on spatial beam self-cleaning via the nonlinear Kerr effect to attain high pulse energy with near Gaussian output beam shape. Moreover, it is found that the wavelength-dependent self-cleaning behavior observed at different wavelengths has distinct threshold. The experimental results are valuable for further comprehend the dynamic characteristics of spatiotemporal mode-locked multimode fiber laser, making them much more accessible for applications.

articleTitle: A Microwave Photonic Multiple Frequency System with Tunable Frequency Multiplication Factor of 3–10
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A microwave photonic system with a tunable frequency multiplication factor of 3–10 is theoretically analyzed and simulated. The system mainly consists of three dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulators (DPMZM). With the use of programmable filter, a fixed-order optical sideband can be accurately obtained as a carrier for secondary modulation. By adjusting the parameters such as the direct current (DC) bias voltage and the radio frequency (RF) drive voltage of each DPMZM in the system, microwave signals with a frequency multiplication factor of 3–10 can be generated. The simulation results show that when the frequency of RF signal is 10GHz, microwave signals with frequencies of 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100GHz can be generated with an unwanted harmonic suppression ratio of 20dB. During the frequency multiplication process, the overlap of the signal in the frequency domain is well avoided because of combining an optical programmable filter. In addition, the process of multi-frequency signal generation is theoretically derived, and the effects of several non-ideal factors on the radio frequency spurious suppression ratio (RFSSR) are analyzed.

articleTitle: Generation of dual-wavelength square wave pulse in a passively mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We report a passively mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser operating in the region of dissipative soliton resonance with dual wavelength square pulse output at 1531 nm and 1557 nm based on nonlinear fiber loop mirror.

articleTitle: A FTN rate transmission scheme for multi-band optical transmission systems
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We introduce a transmission scheme using Fast-than-Nyquist rate in multi-band optical transmission system. A method of non-orthogonal transmission through doubinary filter is proposed and applied in multi-band optical transmission system. The simulation results show that FTN transmission can enhance the spectral efficiency of system, and we can restore signal through force zero equalization technology.

articleTitle: Au triangles array as saturable absorber for a 1.5 $\mu \mathbf{m}$ passively mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we report a passive mode-locking erbium-doped fiber laser (EDFL) that using Au triangles array (Au TA) as saturable absorber fabricated successfully on the fiber tips (OFTs) by nanosphere lithography technology. By using the nanosphere with diameter of 1300 nm, we obtain the localized surface plasmon resonance (LSPR) supported by the Au TA near the C-band (1614 nm). The stable passively mode-locked laser based on Au TA is obtained with a repetition rate of 2.08 MHz and a pulse period of 480 ns for a pump power of 704 mW at 1558 nm. These result may provide a reference in fields of nonlinear optics, micro nano sensing, medical imaging.

articleTitle: Optical Nyquist Pulses Generation by Recirculating Frequency Shifting
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: By recirculating frequency shifting, optical Nyquist pulses with tunable duty cycle are generated.

articleTitle: Analysis on adaptability and training methods of Photonic Reservoir Computing in compensating nonlinear effects
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Photonic reservoir computing (RC) is proved to be an effective method to recover optical communication signal. In this paper, the adaptability and effectiveness of RC to recover signals at different transmission distances are verified by employing photonic RC model; in addition, performance of the system is investigated using three different linear regression training methods. The analysis results show that when the number of virtual nodes is more than 600, the bit-error-rate (BER) is much lower using Levenberg-Marquardt than the other two methods.

articleTitle: Bit-Wise Achievable Information Rates for Probabilistically Shaped 64-QAM in the Presence of Bandwidth Narrowing due to Cascaded Wavelength Selective Switches
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An efficient procedure is presented for evaluating the performance implications of bandwidth narrowing due to cascaded WSSs on probabilistically shaped and uniform 64- QAM using the BW AIR. The constellation distribution that yields the optimum shaping gain in BW AIR for a given SNR depends on the extent of the narrowing.

articleTitle: OFDM-based Underwater Visible Light Communication: System construction and performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Underwater visible light communication system (UVLC) based on OFDM modulation was proposed and the constellation diagram as well as transceiver signal waveforms was obtained by simulation to evaluate the system performance.

articleTitle: A robustness optimization scheme for location-assisted on-demand routing protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An optimization scheme for Location-Assisted On-demand Routing protocol is proposed in order to improve its robustness. The simulation shows that proposed scheme can improve the robustness and reduce the routing cost of LEO routing system.

articleTitle: Experimental observation of Conventional and Bound Optical Soliton Buildup via TS-DFT technique
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We experimentally observed the buildup process of conventional and bound optical solitons via time stretched dispersion Fourier transform technique in two Erbium doped fiber lasers. The mode locking with femtosecond soliton operation was realized by the nonlinear polarization rotation mechanism. The result shows that the random pulses generated firstly, then small pulses was reduced and the main pulse was narrowed and strengthened to form the optical soliton, steady soliton operation was realized after a rapid self-frequency-shifting. The bound soliton was formed as single soliton separation with time interval variation.

articleTitle: Graphene oxide-coated microfiber interferometric biosensor for detecting AFP
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a graphene oxide (GO) functionalized microfiber is proposed and used for immunodetection of alpha-fetoprotein. First, the standard single mode fiber was formed into tapered structure by optical fiber fusion splicer, then microfiber was fabricated by the heat-drawing. Finally, a functionalized microfiber coated with GO is used to detect AFP. The results demonstrated that the detection sensitivity of microfiber is ~1.471 nm/log(mg/ml) within the range of 1 to 10000 pg/mL. Due to high sensitivity, compact structure, low cost, the microfiber coated with GO has great potential in medical field.

articleTitle: Low-complexity Coherent Transceivers for Intra-Datacenter Optical Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a self-homodyne coherent detection (SHCD) system using 25 GHz modulator and 30 GHz photodiode. 480Gb/s PDM-16QAM transmission is realized in 10 km and 2 km with simplified digital signal processing.

articleTitle: Study on Single-Terminal Transmission Visibility Meter based on reflector
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this study, a single-terminal transmission visibility meter is set up by the reflector. This single-terminal transmission visibility meter can reduce the difficulty of installation and commissioning while ensure the accuracy of detection. In this system, two-stage beam expansion is used to obtain better laser collimation, thus, the optical length can reach at 1 km. The lock-in amplifier is used in signal processing to improve the measurement accuracy. The accuracy of the system measurement results is ensured by the calibrated neutral density filters and optical power meters. Good consistency is shown in the calibration. The experimental results show that the design scheme of the single-terminal transmission visibility meter based on reflector is feasible.

articleTitle: MOF-Derived CO3O4-Ni polyhedra for 109th harmonic generation
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Porous CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>-Ni metal organic frameworks (MOFs) were prepared by annealing method, and saturable absorber (SA) based on the MOFs was prepared. Using this SA, the 109th harmonic pulses were obtained in erbium-doped fiber laser (EDFL).

articleTitle: Image Edge Enhancement Technique Using a Novel Optical Vortex Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to producing optical vortex filter by using a Sinc function, called the Sinc spatial filter (SSF). We prove that the SSF can realize a high contrast edge enhancement.

articleTitle: Intelligent performance monitoring for high-speed short-reach optical networks
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Performance monitoring approaches in 100/400/800 Gbit/s short-reach transmissions with advanced modulation formats are developed. The MSEs of the monitored OSNRs are less than 0.1 dB and accuracies of 100% have been achieved in MFI.

articleTitle: Carbon dioxide detection system based on TDLAS technology
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Tunable semiconductor laser absorption spectroscopy (TDLAS) technology has high sensitivity and reliability. Moreover, it can realize real-time online detection. In the detection of trace gases, it has a good application prospect. This article mainly introduces the basic theory of TDLAS technology in carbon dioxide (CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) gas detection. It also introduces the application of TDLAS technology in various field of gas detection and some kinds of traditional CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas detection. The research of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> absorption spectra in different regions of the infrared atmospheric window by many scholars are introduced. And it introduces the process of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas detection and the functions of the instruments involved in the process.

articleTitle: Cu2+ Detecting by Using Optical Fiber Mach-Zehnder Interferometer Coated with CS/PAA
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Optical fiber copper (II) ions (Cu2+) sensor based on an optical fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) formed by cascading two micro fibers is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The MZI is surface-functionized by coating a chitosan/polyacrylic acid multilayer film using a layer-by-layer self-assembly technology. The achieved measurement sensitivity and detection limit are 62.44 dB/mM and 0.0086 mM, respectively, when the copper (II) ions concentration is between 0.005 mMol and 0.1 mMol.

articleTitle: The sensitivity enhancement based on the Au & black phosphorus composite film for the surface plasma resonance fiber sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The newly sensitivity enhancement mechanism about Au & black phosphorus composite film based on surface plasma resonance (SPR) fiber sensor. The sensor was fabricated by a 35 nm aurum (Au) film and 5–10 nm black phosphorus (BP) thin film, which integrated to the surface of fiber. The sensitivity enhancement level can reach as high as 140 % compared with the common Au SPR sensor at the 1.35 refractive index (RI) region. In addition, this newly style fiber structure is extremely suitable for the biochemical sensing.

articleTitle: Light Source Heated Optical Fiber Thermal Anemometer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A highly sensitive optical fiber anemometer is demonstrated by using a polymer Fabry-Perot interferometer (FPI) fabricated on the tip of a single-mode fiber. The polymer FPI absorbs light injected by the broadband light source and generates heat. Its temperature is therefore increased to a certain value which is higher than that of the environment. When airflow is applied, its temperature is reduced and the interference spectrum shifts correspondingly because of the airflow induced cooling effect and wind force. Airflow velocity is therefore measurable by detecting wavelength shift of the optical fiber anemometer. High sensitivity up to −3.13nm /(m/s) is achieved and the response time is ~250 ms.

articleTitle: Research on polarization characteristics of comb filter based on microfiber Sagnac ring
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A comb filter based on microfiber Sagnac ring is proposed. The transmission spectrum of the proposed comb filter is theoretically analyzed. And the polarization characteristics of the comb filter are experimentally demonstrated. The experimental results show that the variation of polarization angle will cause the transmission spectrum drift and the filter depth variation. The variation of wave peak intensity is approximately sinusoidal waveforms through rotating the polarization controller. By studying the polarization characteristics of the comb filter, the comb filter can be better applied to dense wavelength division multiplexing system.

articleTitle: A Gas Recognition Method Based on PCA and PSO-LSSVM
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Gases in the real environment always exist in the form of mixtures, and effective identification of gas types to reduce the occurrence of safety incidents has become an important direction in the field of gas analysis research. This paper proposes a mixed gas identification method based on PCA and PSO-LSSVM. This method uses principal component analysis (PCA) to reduce the dimensionality of the sensor array output signal, and uses the Relief algorithm to select data. The particle swarm algorithm is used to iteratively optimize the relevant parameters in the least squares support vector machine model, and the PSO-LSSVM model is constructed to qualitatively analyze the composition of the mixed gas. This article uses a public data set of mixed gases of ethylene, methane and carbon monoxide to conduct experiments. The experimental results show that the method used in this paper can effectively identify the type of mixed gas, and the recognition accuracy rate reaches 91.67%. The method proposed in this paper can provide a research foundation for the follow-up analysis of the mixed gas concentration.

articleTitle: Enhanced Bragg Resonances in Small Period Long Period Fiber Grating Fabricated with Femtosecond Laser Line by Line Technique
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Small period long period fiber grating is fabricated by femtosecond laser line by line technique. High order Bragg resonances, which are useful for dual-/multi- parameter sensing, are significantly enhanced (from ~0.6 dB to ~11 dB).

articleTitle: Proactive Dynamic Calendar Allocation Scheme for 5G/B5G Transport Network Slicing Based Flexible Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposed a proactive calendar allocation scheme that enhances utilization for optical network resource and provides differentiated service for network slicing. The simulation shows utilization improvement from 72.8% to 81.2% under the evaluated scenario.

articleTitle: Thulium-doped fiber random laser using random fiber grating for random feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We report on a Thulium-doped fiber random laser which uses a random fiber grating for distributed random feedback. The random fiber grating fabricated by using a femtosecond laser provides enhanced Rayleigh scattering in random feedback fiber so the total fiber length of the Thulium-doped fiber random laser is greatly reduced. A high-reflectivity fiber Bragg grating was used to form a half-open cavity structure. Random lasing at 1940 nm with optical signal-to-noise ratio up to 56 dB is achieved.

articleTitle: Fabry-perot cavity array based on-chip waveguide spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A Fourier-transform Raman integrated spectrometer based on 650 Fabry-Perot-cavity array with a total size of 0.4 cm2 is proposed. It can work from 820 nm to 930 nm with a resolution of 5 cm-1.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Optical Sideband Transmitters
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Optical single sideband (SSB) technique has recently attracted considerable attentions as an alternative transmitter for metro-haul applications. The optical SSB technique can double the spectral efficiency and is free from dispersion-induced power fading, compared with conventional double-sideband (DSB) signals. However, the optical SSB transmitter is much more complicated than that of the optical DSB system. In this paper, we review the monolithically integrable optical single sideband (SSB) transmitters that are potentially used for cost-sensitive inter-datacenter interconnects. The focus will be on the optical SSB transmitter scheme of modulating a directly modulated laser and an electro-absorption modulator simultaneously.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Output Power Characteristics of Tunable Thulium-Doped Fiber Ring Lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We investigate output power characteristics of a tunable thulium-doped fiber ring laser (TDFRL) by theoretical simulation. The effects of emission wavelength, active fiber length, output coupling ratio and total intracavity loss on laser output power are investigated.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Advanced Modulation Formats for Low-bandwidth optics-based 50-Gb/s/λ PON at O-band
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A comprehensive comparison of PAM-4, CAP-16QAM and DMT-16QAM modulations is simulated in 50-Gb/s/λPON based on bandwidth-limited optics at O-band. The power budget, thermal noise performance and DSP complexity are discussed. The results show that over 29 dB power budget at 3.8×10-3 threshold can be achieved.

articleTitle: Global and Full-Spectrum Perception for Agile Optical-Wireless Converged Networks in 5G and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A system consisted of spectrum acquisition and transmission network and radio frequency channelization receiver is proposed to achieve global and full-spectrum perception, which could help the communication system make better use of the spectrum resources.

articleTitle: An InP-InGaAs-NiO p-i-n photodiode with partially depleted-absorber and depleted nonabsorbing region
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An InP-InGaAs-NiO p-i-n photodiode achieving p-side full coverage electrode and top illumination by using NiO films is proposed. This structure increases DC saturation current by about 27mA than conventional structure and has better bandwidth.

articleTitle: Tunable DFB Laser Array for Multi-gas Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We designed a tunable Distributed FeedBack (DFB) laser array with a large tuning range based on Reconstruction-Equivalent-Chirp (REC) technique near the wavelength of 1650nm for the first time. We experimentally demonstrated that the laser with wavelength ranging from 1650.4nm to 1657.6nm can be continuously adjusted by selecting the corresponding channel and changing the bias current to detect methane, water vapor, carbon dioxide and carbon monoxide. Furthermore, the idea of this DFB laser for gas detection without Thermo Electric Cooler (TEC) is put forward at last.

articleTitle: Effects of Polarization on the Nonlinear Pulse Propagation in Multimode Fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A model is proposed for the polarization dependent nonlinear pulse propagation in multimode fiber. Based on this model, the effects of polarization on the nonlinear modal interaction, including the spatial beam self-cleaning, are analyzed.

articleTitle: Efficient perovskite light-emitting diodes with modified hole injection layer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Perovskite materials are considered as candidate for the next generation solid state luminescent materials for their exceptional optoelectronic properties, for instance low defect density, high fluorescence quantum efficiency, and high color fineness. To produce highly efficient perovskite light-emitting diodes (PeLEDs), better-matched energy level alignment between the functional layers is of vital significant. In this work, we use poly (sodium-p-styrene-sulfonate) (PSSNa) modified PEDOT: PSS as the hole injection layer to improve hole injection into perovskite emissive layer and inhibit the interfacial exciton quenching. The external quantum efficiency (EQE) of the CsPbBr3-based PeLEDs is improved from 5.65% to 7.81%.

articleTitle: Development of a fluidic pressure sensor by using a surface modified fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A normal fiber Bragg grating (FBG) is insensitivity to pressure in transverse direction, so it is difficult used in fluidic pressure measurement directly. Therefore, based on the sensing characteristics of FBG, a double flange cylinder structure is designed and fabricated, and a new type of an optical fiber fluidic pressure sensor is presented in this paper. In low pressure aqueous environment, the measurement sensitivity is enhanced significantly. The proposed sensor configuration described in this paper exhibit sensitivity of about 10 nm/MPa through the experimental verification, which is 3333 times of the bare FBG sensitivity. In addition, the sensor has the advantages of simple fabrication and assembly, high stability, good linearity and repeatability, etc.

articleTitle: A FBG and Magnetostrictive Alloy based Magnetic Field Sensor with the Demodulation realized by Optoelectronic Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A FBG and magnetostrictive alloy based magnetic field optical sensor is realized with the demodulation by a new dual-loop optoelectronic oscillator (OEO). Unlike the previously reported OED-based sensing schemes, the stability of this proposed scheme is enhanced by using the combination of a fiber ring laser (FRL) cavity and a dual-loop OEO structure. The sensitivity of −48.40476 Hz/mT is obtained. The stability is up to 0.194 ppm.

articleTitle: Design of a remote multi-channel high-precision strain acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a remote multi-channel high-precision strain acquisition system based on stm32 is designed, and the system can be verified to meet the expected requirements after testing.

articleTitle: Optical Integrated Sensor Based on 2×4 Multimode Interference Coupler and Intensity Mechanism with a High Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a new structure for generating a Fano shape. This structure can be applied to design an optical sensor with a high sensitivity based on intensity mechanism using a 2×4 multimode interference (MMI) coupler. The sensor structure can provide a very sensitivity (higher than 10 times) compared with the traditional structure based on Mach Zehnder interferometer (MZI) and microring resonators (MRR). For CMOS compatibility, we use silicon on insluator (SOI) waveguide for the whole sensor designs. The sensing structure can work at operating wavelength of 1550nm, that is suitable for fiber-optic communication and real-time measurement applications.

articleTitle: Opto-Electronic Neural Networks Based on Few-Mode Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this work, for the first time to our knowledge, the spatial degrees of freedom are introduced to opto-electronic neural networks, and the few-mode fiber based multiplexing is numerically simulated to realize parallel synapses.

articleTitle: OFDR based curvature sensing with quasi-single mode operated few-mode fibers
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We demonstrate a distributed curvature sensor based on quasi-single mode Rayleigh backscattering in few mode fiber(FMF). FMF has a larger mode field than a single mode fiber and is, therefore, more sensitive to bending. In this paper, we combine FMF with Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometry (OFDR) mechanism to make full use of the spatial characteristics of quasi-single mode, to obtain high precision and spatial resolution curvature sensing.

articleTitle: Design of interference system for portable Fourier transform infrared gas analyzer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a novel interference system for portable Fourier transform infrared gas analyzer was developed. Compared to the traditional Michelson interferometer, 4 times optical path difference can be obtained at a small swing angle by swinging a structure with double cube corner mirrors of the system. Simultaneously, the portability and vibration resistance of the system are also enhanced. A compact Fourier gas analyzer with the inversion infrared spectrum range of 1110 ~ 5000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> was realized with the interference system. Validated by measuring the concentrations of different gradients, the results showed that the error of inversion concentration is less than 1%, which indicates the interference system has potential to be embedded in portable Fourier infrared gas analyzer for on-line comparison and supervision.

articleTitle: A high stability microfiber Sagnac loop refractive index sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A Sagnac loop liquid refractive index sensor is proposed based on SMF-Tapered TCF-SMF (STS) and FBG. In the refractive index range of 1.333-1.3465 and 1.3515-1.363, the sensitivity is 5521.6nm/RIU and 7173.8nm/RIU, respectively. By cascading FBG, the random fluctuation of wavelength is reduced from±0.862nm to 0.004nm. It can effectively filter out part of the cladding mode and improve the stability of the sensor.

articleTitle: Gb/s physical-layer secure key generation and distribution in fiber communications
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We present the high-speed physical-layer secure key generation and distribution in fiber networks. A key generation rate of 2.7 Gb/s is achieved over 10 km single-mode fiber using a specifically-designed bidirectional polarization scrambler.

articleTitle: Differential Fresnel Reflection Based Fiber-optic Relative Humidity Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Simple fiber-optic differential Fresnel reflection based relative humidity sensor with large dynamic range on is proposed and investigated. The response rate and the stability of the sensor are also addressed.

articleTitle: Multicore Fiber Bragg Gratings Array Shape Sensor Fabricated with an Auto-Alignment Femtosecond Laser Point-by-Point Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Distributed fiber-optic shape sensor has been a powerful tool for variety of applications, such as structural deformation, minimally invasive surgery, and micro robotics in harsh environments. Such sensor, however, are incompatible with the demand of long-distance distributed sensing or high spatial resolution measurement. By utilizing the combination of image recognition and micro-displacement compensation, we demonstrate an auto-alignment femtosecond laser point-by-point technology, that capable of inscribing fiber Bragg grating (FBG) array through protective coating in commercial seven-core fiber. Based on the proposed method, a shape sensor array consisting of 140 FBGs has been created. Implementation of this sensor array has shown a maximum bend sensitivity of 55.49 pm/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>and a maximum error per unit length of 4.51 % in shape reconstruction.

articleTitle: Cost-efficient Fiber-wireless-fiber Integration System at 28-GHz Ka-band for 5G Millimeter-wave Coverage Scenario
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We have proposed a cost-efficient fiber-wireless-fiber integration system at 28GHz Ka-band using one ECL and one EML, and experimentally demonstrated 14.375Gbit/s DMT-32QAM signals transmission over a 2-m wireless link between 2-km and 3-km fiber links.

articleTitle: Wavefront regulation of terahertz frequency based on all-silicon medium coded metasurface
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A 2D artificial electromagnetic metasurface has become a hot topic in recent years. By designing geometric or electromagnetic parameters on a small size, it can achieve flexible and effective regulation of electromagnetic characteristics. Metal waveguides and metal resonators are widely used in traditional structures. The ohmic loss caused by metal materials will seriously affect the coding efficiency of the metasurface. To solve this problem, we propose an all-silicon medium metasurface. The coded metasurface is constructed by designing different basic coding sequences to control the terahertz frequency wavefront.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 200-Gb/s DMT Signal Using Entropy Loading
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated a 200-Gb/s DMT signal transmission over 2-km or 10-km SSMF with bit loading or entropy loading using a 23-GHz MZM, respectively. The BER is below 20% SD-FEC threshold.

articleTitle: All-fiber second-order Mode Converter Based on Twisted Long-period Fiber Grating
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We demonstrated a twisted long-period fiber grating mode converter to generate LP21 mode. The introduction of twisting could significantly improve the fabrication efficiency and reduce the damage to fiber structure.

articleTitle: Surface Engineering of PTAA by adding Al2O3interfacial layer for Inverted Perovskite Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have shown an enormous potential due to their excellent performance and simple architecture with low temperature and solution processing compatibility. PTAA, with good stability and well-matched energy levels, becomes a superior hole transport candidate for inverted PSC devices, however, its hydrophobic nature brings some processing problems. To address this dilemma, we adopt mesoporous Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>nanocrystal as an interface control layer to modulate the wettability of perovskite solution. It has been demonstrated that the Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>interfacial layer decreases the surface energies of PTAA and enables a better homogeneous perovskite film with improved coverage and increased crystallite size.

articleTitle: Doppler coherent wind lidar based on golvanometer scanner
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to improve the detection probability of wind lidar and realize three-dimensional velocity measurement, we propose a single-beam wind lidar based on golvanometer scanner, which realize velocity azimuth display scanning and measure radical velocity 360° on the circle at fixed height.

articleTitle: Broad Spectrum Characteristics of Bi/Er co-doped Silica Optical Fiber in C-band
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The spectral and gain characteristics of Bi/Er codoped silica optical fiber are investigated in this paper. The fiber provides four obvious absorption peaks, which result from the energy level transitions of Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Bi iron. The fiber exhibits ultra-broadband luminescence spectrum region between 1100 and 1700 nm when pumped by 980 nm laser. And the maximum gain of the fiber can reach 34 dB at 1534 nm when the pump power is 131.3 mW. Those prove that this fiber is conducive to the application of laser and amplifier.

articleTitle: FSS:A Fast Switch System Based on AWGR for Optical Datacenter Network
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A flexible and fast switch system based on AWGR to enable optical datacenter networks is proposed and numerically investigated. Results validate that the packet loss is less than 18.84%, latency is less than 11.7 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{s}$</tex>.

articleTitle: High Q Nanobeam cavity based on etchless lithium niobate integrated platform
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Photonic bound states in the continuum (BICs) applied in the thin-film lithium-niobate-on-insulator (LNOI) has been exploited in multiple systems since it obviates the limitations of nano-fabrication. Here we firstly propose a nanobeam structure with BIC exhibiting a high Q factor of over 7000 with the length of only ~100 μm.

articleTitle: NoPeak: An Intelligent Multi-hop Scheduling Scheme for Optical Data Center
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The ever-increasing bandwidth requirements of modern datacenters have led researchers to employ optical circuit switching (OCS) to reduce the cost of data center networks, but most of these proposals these schemes assume that the traffic in the network is uniform, which will lead to the traffic cannot be fully invoked in the real environment. We propose an intelligent multi-hop scheduling algorithm capable of supporting any one hop scheduling algorithm to reduce the impact of traffic imbalance on the overall performance of the network. Through the intelligent multi-hop method, the algorithm can transport the oversubscribed traffic with the minimum overall link occupancy. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can reduce the average end-to-end delay by 46.4% and the average stream completion time by 51%, and the throughput is improved by 20.1%.

articleTitle: Ternary blend hostes for solution processed green phosphorescent organic light-emitting diodes
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper a series of solution processed green phosphorescent organic light-emitting diodes (PhOLEDs) based on blend hosts-guest configuration have been fabricated and the effect of various hole transport materials, e.g. 1,3-Di-9- carbazolylbenzene (mCP), poly(9-vinylcarbazole) (PVK) and 4,4′,4″-tris(N-carbazolyl)-triphenylamine (TCTA) and their combination as the hosts on the performance of PhOLEDs have investigated. It is found that the device with the ternary blend host (mCP:PVK:TCTA) doped with tris(2-(p-tolyl)pyridine-C2,N)iridium(III) (Ir(mppy)3) as a green guest material can achieve a luminance of 10213 cd m-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> at a driven voltage of 7 volts, the uppermost external quantum efficiency (EQE) of 16.91%, and a small roll over and maintain EQE of 12.95% at 1000 cd m-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with the CIE coordinates of (0.31,0.61). Compared with the corresponding single and binary host systems (mCP, 4600.49 cd m-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 14.62%, 24.90%; PVK, 5116.74 cd m-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, 15.77%, 19.78%; mCP:PVK, 5275.05 cd m-2, 16.99%, 22.07%), the PhOLED based on ternary-host materials has the optimal performance. The superior electroluminescence (EL) performance for ternary blend host-based green PhOLEDs was attributed to the efficient energy transfer from the host to dopant, the appropriate highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) level and the enhanced charge carrier transport balance.

articleTitle: Damage Monitoring of Ballastless Track Slab Based on Optical Fiber Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A real-time monitoring for ballastless track slab damage based on optical fiber accelerometers is proposed. The field test on the Beijing-Shanghai high-speed railway in China shows that this method can effectively identify the damaged track slabs.

articleTitle: A polarization-multiplexed coherent RoF link with simple digital laser-phase-noise cancellation
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We present a polarization-multiplexed coherent RoF link with simple digital laser-phase-noise cancellation. In the experiments, 25-km fiber transmission of four 64-QAM microwave vector signals with error vector magnitudes (EVMs) of less than 10% is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Performance of Wavelength Division Multiplexing System Based on V-Cavity Semiconductor Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The improvement of optical communication systems' transmission capacity and bandwidth requirements and the emergence of wavelength division multiplexing technology means a huge demand for low-cost tunable lasers. In this paper, the intensity modulation performance of a low-cost tunable laser v-cavity tunable laser is studied. The wavelength division multiplexing system link and the free space optical communication system link in the indoor environment are built, respectively. The direct modulation performance is analyzed by measuring the eye pattern, signal-to-noise ratio, bit error rate, and extinction ratio.

articleTitle: A novel training symbol structure design for transmitter IQ mismatch estimation and compensation in CO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a new training symbol structure consists of two adjacent training symbols is proposed to estimate transmitter in-phase/quadrature(IQ) mismatch and channel information in coherent optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (CO-OFDM) system. Each training symbol of the proposed scheme has two subsets which are mirror images of each other, and one subset values are set to zeros. Simulation in high speed gives the results that proved the proposed scheme increased the system performance.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of 260km Unrepeatered Transmission System using Third Order DRA and ROPA
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A joint optimization method is proposed for a 260 km unrepeatered transmission system using bidirectional third-order Raman amplifiers and remote optically pumped amplifiers. The simulation results show that the designed Raman amplifiers with the jointly optimized pump parameters obtain a loss budget of 54.98 dB and a gain flatness of 0.7398 dB. In the case of providing the same loss budget, the proposed joint optimization method improves the gain flatness by 0.634 dB. The proposed scheme provides a feasible alternative for the performance improvement of the future ultra-long unrepeatered transmission system.

articleTitle: Generation of Collinear Superimposed Orbital Angular Momentum Modes Using a Phase-only Grating
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, an Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) generation method based on Adapted Mutation Particle Swarm Optimization (AM-PSO) algorithm is proposed. Based on the traditional iterative algorithm, the AM-PSO algorithm simultaneously generates multiple OAM modes with higher iterative efficiency. The simulation results show that 20 evenly spaced OAM modes are generated through a phase-only grating with high diffraction efficiency and low relative root-mean-square error (R-RMSE). Moreover, the relative power distribution can be easily manipulated by adjusting the weight coefficients of OAM modes.

articleTitle: High-resolution fiber optic Fabry-Perot seismometer for low frequency monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A high-resolution fiber optic Fabry-Perot seismometer for low frequency monitoring is presented. The noise level of the proposed seismometer is 6.74 ng/√Hz, which is better than NHNM within 0.16-50 Hz.

articleTitle: A Multi-Channel Tunable Periodic Narrowband Filter Chip Composed of Cascaded Silicon Nitride Microring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A multi-channel tunable periodic narrowband filter chip composed of cascaded silicon nitride (Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>) microring resonators (MRR) is proposed and implemented in this paper. We have assembled eight MRRs with the same structure on a silicon based chip with a size of 9mm*1.8mm. The waveguide material is silicon nitride with low transmission loss, and its transmission loss is about 0.2dB/cm. The central wavelength of the MRR can be tuned by thermal-optical effect. The experimental results show that the FSR is about 260GHz, the channel's 3dB bandwidth range is 0.7B-1.33GHz, the thermal modulation coefficient is about 0.33GHz/mW, and the central frequency tuning range is about 60GHz. The chip has the following features, including multi-channel, narrow bandwidth and wide tuning range, which can be used in microwave photonic system instead of traditional optical filters.

articleTitle: A Compact and Low-loss TE Mode-order Converter Based on LNOI Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper proposes a compact and high-efficient mode converter based on Lithium-Niobate-on-isolator platform. The size of the mode converter is 8 × 3.6 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the TE0-to-TE1 conversion efficiency is 93.46% at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Miniature Fiber-optic Modal Interferometer Based on Ultrasonic-Cutting Technique for Low-range Refractive Index Sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A fiber-optic modal interferometer is proposed and experimentally investigated for low-range refractive index sensing. This interferometer is fabricated by ultrasonic-cutting technique with a sensitivity of 12085.1 nm/RIU, which makes it an application in biological fields.

articleTitle: Research on FFT Demodulation System of Double Fiber Laser Beat Signal Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, based on FPGA, a wide-band, high-resolution, low-cost dual-channel fiber laser beat signal demodulation system is studied, which combines mixing technology and Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). It is used to demodulate the frequency difference information of dual-channel laser signal in real time. Based on the principle of optical heterodyne detection, two single-frequency fiber lasers with central wavelengths of 1550.001~1550.601nm output dual-channel laser signals with a wavelength interval of 5~30pm are used to conduct the experiment of beat signal demodulation system. The experiment proves that the circuit can realize realtime detection of beat signal in the frequency band of 0.41~3.45GHz. Frequency resolution up to 7.6kHz.

articleTitle: Random grating-array-based tunable random fiber laser with a full-open cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We proposed a tunable random fiber laser with compact structure. A π-FBG is used to select and adjust different lasing wavelengths. Two random Bragg grating arrays form the full-open-cavity structure. It has low lasing-threshold and several hundred picometers turning range.

articleTitle: Vector Mode Converters Based on Cascaded LPFGs in Elliptical Ring-Core Fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A broadband vector mode converter is proposed based on cascaded long-period fiber gratings in elliptical ring-core fiber. The 20-dB bandwidths of all vector mode (TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>, HE<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">even</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>,HE<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">odd</sup><inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> and TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</inf>) converters are around 100 nm.

articleTitle: Study on Frequency-dependent Saturation Characteristics of Modified Uni-traveling Carrier Photodetector
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The frequency-dependent RF output characteristics of the modified uni-traveling carrier photodetector are studied. The results show that RF saturation output power of the device decreases linearly with increasing of the incident signal frequency.

articleTitle: Research on integrated platform for multiple parameters intelligent monitoring of DWDM optical fiber signal
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An integrated platform for multiple parameters intelligent monitoring of dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) optical fiber signal by utilizing the advanced telecom computing architecture (ATCA) is proposed and discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Impact of Nonlinearity in EDFAs on High-Speed Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We model the nonlinear interaction of ultrashort pulse train in EDFAs in high-speed systems based on the semi-classical theory. The intra-channel crosstalk in optical comb due to the resonantly enhanced nonlinearity in EDFAs is simulated.

articleTitle: High-Performance Microwave Frequency Comb Generation Using Optically Injected Semiconductor Laser with Dual-loop Optoelectronic Feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: An approach to generating microwave frequency combs (MFCs) with superior performance is proposed and experimentally demonstrated based on an optically injected semiconductor laser (OISL). In this scheme, an OISL subject to a short-delay optoelectronic feedback loop is firstly applied to produce the initial MFC based on Fourier domain mode-locking, and a long-delay loop is added to improve the signal quality based on the self-injection-locking technique. In the experimental demonstration, a K-band MFC (18–26 GHz) with a line-spacing of 8.45 MHz has been obtained, and the comb contrast ratio is over 45 dB. In addition, the generated MFC exhibited superior performance in terms of spectral purity. Each comb component has a linewidth below 500 Hz and a phase noise below −90 dBc/Hz at 10kHz offset, demonstrating an excellent phase coherence between each comb component.

articleTitle: IDENTIFYING MODULATION FORMATS USING INTEGRATED CLUSTERING ALGORITHM
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose an integrated-clustering-algorithm-base modulation format identification scheme. Experiments shows that it can achieves 100% identification accuracy when OSNR is lower than 7% FEC threshold and have a good tolerate to residual chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Measurement of Young's Modulus of Metallic Materials Based on Fiber Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Young's modulus, as an important parameter in material mechanics, plays an important role in engineering design and teaching research. Fiber Bragg grating, as the most popular optical sensor device, has outstanding advantages such as high sensitivity and strong anti-interference. Therefore, this article uses 42CrMo alloy steel as the measurement material. A design method for measuring the Young's modulus of metallic materials using fiber Bragg gratings and pressure sensors is proposed. The Young's modulus of the metal to be tested is obtained through experiments. And compared with the Young's modulus of standard materials. The design method is simple and the measurement accuracy is high.

articleTitle: CS2-Filled Solid-Core Photonic Crystal Fiber for Temperature Sensing Based on Photonic Bandgap Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose a temperature sensor based on CS2-filled photonic crystal fiber. The sensor has a average sensitivity of up to 4.60nm/°C in the range of −50 to 40°C.

articleTitle: Enhancement of single-photon emission rate by plasmon induced transparency in metal-insulator-metal waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a structure that realizes the plasmon induced transparency (PIT) effect through metal-insulator-metal waveguide and T-shaped resonator. PIT is a quantum interference effect, which can lead to a sharp transparency window in the wide absorption spectrum. By changing the coupling strength between the light and dark states of PIT effect, the distribution of electromagnetic field around the quantum-dot nanowire can be affected. Theoretical analysis showed the Purcell effect caused by the T-shaped resonator increases the emission rate of quantum dots by nearly 900 times. This ultrafast single-photon source has great potential in quantum communication and optical interconnection.

articleTitle: Sideband Ampilification Injection Locking Effect in Integrated Mutual Injection DFB Laser
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The sideband amplification injection locking (SAIL) effect in the integrated mutual injection laser has been researched. Based on the SAIL effect in the integrated laser, the microwave photonics filter (MPF), the optoelectronic oscillator (OEO) and sideband modulation (SSB) in ROF link are proposed and experimentally realized. The SAIL effect expands the application of integrated optical injection laser in microwave photonics.

articleTitle: Energy Transfer and Tuning of Photoluminescence in the BaMgAl10O17: Cr3+ Eu2+ Phosphor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this work, the BaMgAl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf>: Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>, Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> phosphor was successfully obtained via solid state reaction, showing efficient energy transfer between Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> with the energy transfer efficiency (ηT) maximal value of 30.3%. The optimal phosphors show excellent thermal stability (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">423K</inf>/I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">298K</inf>=55.73%) Adding the Eu<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> improved the absorption in the ultraviolet region of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> and enhancing the NIR emission intensity of BAM: Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> phosphors by energy transfer, which is expected to be applied to silicon substrate solar cell.

articleTitle: Dam Deformation of High Precision GNSS Satellite Research on Calibration Method of Monitor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In order to ensure the data validity of the GNSS dam deformation monitor with high precision, a method for calibrating the GNSS satellite dam deformation monitor with high precision is presented, which makes the GNSS satellite dam deformation monitor with high precision trace to the national standard effectively. First, the working principle of the GNSS satellite dam deformation monitor with high precision is analyzed. Next, using the GNSS receiver calibration field, calibrate the indication error of the high-precision GNSS dam deformation monitor. Finally, the calibration data is summarized and analyzed, and the uncertainty of the calibration results is evaluated. The experimental results show that the plane measurement accuracy of the GNSS dam deformation monitor with high accuracy is 2mm. The height measurement accuracy is 1 mm and the uncertainty is 0. 6mm, to meet the traceability requirements of high-precision GNSS satellite dam deformation monitor.

articleTitle: A tilted fiber Bragg grating pH sensor coated with polyaniline
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A functionalized tilted fiber grating (TFBG) sensor based on polyaniline (PANI) was proposed for the detection of environmental pH. The pH sensor is fabricated by coating PANI to the surface of optical fiber. The transmission spectrum of the sensor changes significantly with the change of external pH value. Moreover, the sensitivity is directly related to the thickness of the polyaniline film. The test results show that the pH detection range is 2-11.2, and the maximum sensitivity is up to 1.82 dB/pH. Furthermore, the proposed pH sensor exhibits good biochemical compatibility, which exhibits great application prospects in biomedicine field.

articleTitle: An all-optical miniature soil moisture content sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Based on the photothermal conversion effect of doped fiber and the principle of Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) temperature measurement, an all-fiber miniature soil moisture content sensor is developed.

Author Keywords: all-optical fiber soil moisture content sensor

articleTitle: Self-sustained optical frequency comb generation using a phase-modulator-based dual-loop optoelectronic oscillator
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Optical frequency comb (OFC) generation using a phase-modulator-based dual-loop optoelectronic oscillator is demonstrated. A 17-line OFC with a spacing of 10 GHz and a flatness of 7.7 dB is experimentally generated.

articleTitle: Noise Characteristics of Cascading Brillouin random fiber lasers
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The noise properties of a cascading Brillouin random fiber laser are characterized, exhibiting a phase and frequency noise suppression as well as a low-frequency relative intensity noise additive transfer with respect to the 1st Stokes.

articleTitle: Femtosecond Laser-Inscribed Ultra-Weak Fiber Bragg Grating Array for Distributed High-Temperature Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an identical ultra-weak fiber Bragg grating (uwFBG) array inscribed with femtosecond laser point-by-point (PbP) method for distributed high-temperature sensing. An identical uwFBG array including 200 uwFBGs was fabricated along a 2 m conventional single-mode fiber (SMF) with an interval of 10 mm, and interrogated with an optical frequency domain reflectometer (OFDR). In addition, the high-temperature response of uwFBG was studied. The experiment result showed that uwFBG can withstand a high-temperature of 1000°C for long time. After annealing at 1000°C for 20 hours, the heating and cooling responses of uwFBG were basically the same and the uwFBG exhibited a sensitivity of 18.2 pm/¼C at 1000°C. And then, the fabricated identical uwFBG array with OFDR demodulation was used to realize the distributed high-temperature sensing up to 1000°C. Such identical uwFBG array are promising in many distributed high-temperature sensing areas, such as aerospace vehicles, oil and gas explorations, and nuclear plants.

articleTitle: Hybrid-Trusted/Untrusted-Relay based Protection Strategy in Quantum Key Distribution Enabled Optical Networks (QKD-ON)
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper addresses the survivability issue by proposing a hybrid-trusted/untrusted-relay based protection strategy in QKD-ON. Simulation results show it performs well on service blocking rate and protection path construction rate.

articleTitle: Propagation Characteristics of Laguerre-Gaussian Beams with OAM in Atmospheric Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Based on Kolmogorov turbulence phase aberrations, the OAM measurement probabilities of Laguerre-Gaussian beams in atmospheric turbulence are researched. We derive the functions of OAM measurement probabilities varied with propagation distance of Laguerre-Gaussian beams. In addition, we also find that the Laguerre-Gaussian beam propagating in atmospheric turbulence will be less affected if it has smaller initial OAM topological charge.

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of disturbance signal of Cable Tunnel based on Optical Fiber Vibration Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Cable tunnel is easily affected by external force, such as excavating equipment, which leads to abnormal cable and affects normal transmission. In order to detect the abnormal phenomenon of cable tunnel in time, the optical fiber sensing technology is used to monitor the cable tunnel in real time. Four fiber vibration sensors are installed on the roof of cable tunnel and connected to the self-developed optical fiber microseismic monitor. Different vibration signals are simulated directly above the cable tunnel, the time domain and frequency domain information generated by the vibration signal are analyzed, and the source type of the disturbed cable tunnel is identified in order to protect the cable tunnel in time. The results show that there are obvious differences in the main frequency produced by different source types, and the source information can be classified according to different main frequency signals, especially the information of external force damage, so as to protect cables in time and ensure the safety of electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Magneto-refractive characteristics and mechanism of erbium-doped silica fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: The magneto-refractive characteristics of erbium-doped silica fiber (EDF) are of great significance in magnetic field sensing. The fiber doped with rare earth Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> has a large magnetic moment and spin splitting, which makes a major contribution to the magnetic properties of the fiber. The refractive index of EDF in different magnetic fields was measured. The experimental results show that the refractive index of EDF decreases linearly with the increase of magnetic field. The magneto-refractive sensitivity of EDF is 3.21×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−5</sup> RI /mT, which is about 20 times higher than that of single-mode fiber. The magneto-refractive properties of silica fiber are enhanced by rare earth element Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>.

articleTitle: Microwave Photonic Filter based on broadband source sliced by SMF-FMF-SMF structure
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In this paper, a microwave photonic filter (MPF) based on broadband source sliced by SMF-FMF-SMF (SFS) structure is proposed. The performances of the filter are investigated theoretically and experimentally. The response of proposed MPF has similar distribution to the spatial frequency spectrum G of siliced BOS. The effect of BOS on the performance of MPF are discussed by comparing the results of experiment and simulation. Compared with the traditional structure, the proposed MPF has the advantage of resisting external disturbance, which improves the reliability of the filter.

articleTitle: Wearable and Alignment-free Optical Microfiber Device for Human Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: A wearable device based on an alignment-free photonic chip (AFPC) which consists of optical microfiber and flexible liquid chip for precise human health monitoring was developed. High-fidelity physiological signals and vital signs were detected and extracted for cardiovascular health accessment.

articleTitle: New Efficient Four-Dimensional Trellis Coded Modulation Format
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: Two new four-dimensional modulation schemes, 4DTCM-SP-128QAM and 4DTCM-SP-128TQAM, are proposed with lower BER. The simulation show that they can obtain 2.53dB and 1.33dB gain respectively with great potential used in long-haul optical transmission system.

articleTitle: Curvature sensor based on cascaded dual-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: In recent years, as the development of aerospace, road bridge, precisioninstrument and other fields, the requirements of curved detection have become more and more precise and multi-point, and the advantages of fiber curvature sensors have become increasingly obvious. Based on the principle of mode interference, we proposed a cascade single-mode fiber, few-mode fiber and dual-core photonic crystal fiber curvature sensor, which can measure the distribution curvature, and solve the problem of measurement of multiple points that cannot be measured using one sensor. The experiment results show that within 0 to 1.06m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> curvature range, each test point curvature sensitivity and linearity are −1.58 nm/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 0.98135, −1.62 nm/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 0.99504, −1.56 nm/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 0.98301, −1.74 nm/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 0.99701, and −1.31 nm/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 0.97315, respectively.

articleTitle: Novel Fundamental Concepts beneath Quantum Photonics
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: For better understanding of quantum photonics, five novel fundamental concepts are presented. Some typical quantum phenomena such as quantum tunneling, double-slit interference, delayed-choice experiment, quantum eraser experiment and the “uncertainty” relations have been properly re-interpreted and the advancement on full-cosmic-scope relativity has also been introduced.

articleTitle: Development of the Resonant Fiber Optic Gyroscope Prototype
publicationTitle: 2021 19th International Conference on Optical Communications and Networks (ICOCN)
abstract: This paper presents latest progress in the development of a packaged resonant fiber optic gyroscope prototype with a single semiconductor laser, which achieves a bias stability of 0.14°/h and an angle random walk of 0.05 °/ vh.
